cards.title: Parametric (Variance-Covariance) VaR — McNeil Ch.9 §9.2.2
cards.summary_curated: Parametric (variance–covariance / delta-normal) VaR assumes the risk-factor changes are multivariate normal so the linearised portfolio loss is itself normal and VaR reads off as a closed-form quantile; McNeil flags its two crude simplifications — linearisation error and an unrealistic normality assumption for heavy-tailed financial returns.
